scientific_integrity: The claim is proved by explicit rank-one tensor factorization and subspace counting; finite enumeration is a corroborating check, not a universal proof. Prior commuting-pair and graph-degree formulas are acknowledged as covered and are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one, nonzero square-zero matrix vertices only. Not the full nilpotent graph; neither automorphism groups nor connectivity nor spectra are classified. Exhaustive tests cover eight small configurations; independent validation and exhaustive publication-priority checks remain outstanding.
title: Maximal cliques of the rank-one nilpotent commuting graph over finite fields
